JLL arranges $44.2M financing for Hamilton Logistics Center in Salt Lake City
Authors
Grace Lewis
SALT LAKE CITY, June 11, 2026 – JLL Capital Markets announced today it arranged a $44.2 million refinancing for Hamilton Logistics Center, a 474,600-square-foot Class A industrial asset located at 8080 West 1400 North in Salt Lake City, Utah.
JLL worked on behalf of the borrower, Hamilton Partners and Bow River Capital, to secure a floating-rate, five-year loan through a national insurance company.
Completed in 2023, Hamilton Logistics Center is strategically positioned in Salt Lake City's Northwest Quadrant just 10 minutes from Salt Lake City International Airport with exceptional connectivity to Interstate 80, Interstate 215 and Interstate 15. The property's location provides seamless distribution access throughout the Wasatch Front and neighboring western states, with proximity to the Utah Inland Port Authority and Bangerter Highway creating multimodal access linking air cargo, interstate highways and regional rail networks.
The cross-dock industrial facility features 36-foot clear heights, 56 dock-high doors, two drive-in doors and a 2,800-square-foot move-in-ready spec office. The 33.41-acre site includes 244 parking stalls and 156 trailer stalls on paved, illuminated land. The property serves logistics and distribution users with access to the Wasatch Front's labor pool of more than 1.2 million residents.
The JLL Capital Markets team was led by Senior Managing Director Chris Gandy and Analyst Jack Safford, with support from Managing Director Todd Torok.
"The Salt Lake City Northwest Quadrant continues to demonstrate robust fundamentals driven by the region's population growth and its role as a critical distribution hub for the western United States," said Gandy. "Hamilton Logistics Center represents best-in-class industrial product with immediate freeway access and modern specifications that meet the needs of tenants throughout the Wasatch Front."
JLL’s Capital Markets group is a full-service global provider of capital solutions for real estate investors and occupiers. The group’s in-depth local market and global investor knowledge delivers the best-in-class solutions for clients, including investment sales and advisory, debt advisory, M&A and corporate finance, loan sales, equity & fund placement, net lease, derivative advisory and energy & infrastructure advisory. The group has more than 3,000 Capital Markets specialists worldwide with offices in nearly 50 countries.

For over 200 years, clients have trusted JLL, a Fortune 500® company, to help them confidently buy, build, occupy, manage and invest across a variety of industries and property types, including office, industrial, hotel, multi-family, retail and data center properties. Powered by rich global datasets and leading technology capabilities, we provide coordinated, end-to-end delivery of real estate services for a broad range of global clients who represent a wide variety of industries. Through LaSalle Investment Management, we invest for clients on a global basis in both private assets and publicly traded real estate securities. For further information, visit jll.com.
About Hamilton Partners
Hamilton Partners is a commercial real estate and development company that specializes in commercial office, industrial and retail projects. The company is headquartered in Itasca, Illinois and has regional offices in Salt Lake City, Phoenix, and Denver. Hamilton continues to own and operate over 18 million square feet of real estate. The firms’ portfolio is proof the highest quality properties, on average, achieve higher rental rates, attract, and retain stronger credit tenants, and experience higher occupancy. For additional information, visit www.hamiltonpartners.com
About Bow River Capital
Bow River Capital is a private alternative asset management company based in Denver, Colorado, focused on investing in the lower middle market across private credit, private equity, and real estate. Collectively, Bow River has deployed capital into diverse industries, asset classes, and across the capital structure. For more information on Bow River Capital, please visit www.bowrivercapital.com.
